record.field: Every guard rostered at the site today is marked Present, Absent or AWOL, and saved.
Payroll, client billing and AWOL follow-up are all worked out from this register. If it's missing or wrong, guards get paid wrongly and clients get billed wrongly.
At the top of the screen, open Workforce, then choose Posting Console.
The Posting Console is where each site's attendance for the day is recorded, in one place.
Open Workforce in the top menu and choose Posting Console.

Can't see Workforce in the top menu? You may be in a different app. Click the grid icon at the top left, open Security, then Workforce → Posting Console.

Still missing? Your account may not have attendance access. Use Report a problem in DeployGuard.
Set the date to {date} and choose {site}. If there's no sheet yet, press "Create Batch & Generate from Roster".
The sheet is filled from the roster, so every guard who should be there is listed. Nobody is forgotten and nobody is added by hand.
Go back to Workforce → Posting Console.

"No roster slots found"? Nobody is rostered at this site today, so there is nothing to register. Check the date and site. If guards really are working there, the roster needs fixing first: tell the Operations Supervisor.

"Guards not assigned"? The roster has shifts but no guard names. Assign guards in the Roster Board, then come back.
For each guard press Present, Absent or AWOL. When nobody shows "Not Marked", press Save Changes.
Each mark decides what a guard is paid for today, and an AWOL mark starts the follow-up. Mark what actually happened.
Attendance registered. Admin can now confirm it.
Go back to the Posting Console for {site} on {date}.

• Present: the guard came to the post. Add the times if they came late or left early.
  • Absent: they told you they couldn't come (sick, leave).
  • AWOL: they didn't come and didn't tell anyone.

Only use Mark All Present after you've checked that every guard really came.

Nothing is saved until you press Save Changes. The orange number on it shows unsaved marks.
The site's registered attendance has been checked by a second person and confirmed.
A second person checking the register catches mistakes before they reach payroll. You can't confirm a sheet you registered yourself.
Open Workforce in the top menu and choose Posting Console.
Choose {site} and {date}. Check each mark against what you know (call-ins, leave, incidents). If it's right, press "Review & Validate".
Once confirmed, HR can verify the day and send it to payroll.
Confirmed. HR can now verify it.
Go back to Workforce → Posting Console.

No "Review & Validate" button? It only appears once every guard is marked and saved. If guards still show "Not Marked", the register isn't finished: ask the Operations Supervisor to finish it.

Something looks wrong? Don't confirm it. Tell the Operations Supervisor what's wrong so they can correct it first.
The confirmed attendance is verified and locked for payroll.
Locking is what payroll reads from. After it, the day can't be changed by accident.
Open Workforce in the top menu and choose Posting Sheets.
Find {site} on {date} (the "Waiting for HR verification" filter shows only confirmed sheets) and open it.
Go back to Workforce → Posting Sheets.
Check the guards, absences and AWOLs are consistent with leave and HR records, then press "Verify & lock".
This is the last check before payroll. Absences and AWOLs here affect people's pay.
Open {site}'s posting sheet for {date} from Workforce → Posting Sheets.

No "Verify & lock" button? The sheet hasn't been confirmed by Admin yet, or your account isn't in the HR group.

Something doesn't match leave records? Don't lock it. Ask Admin to reopen it with the Operations Supervisor.
